profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at SAIC
profile.summary: Systems integration and test engineering professional with 13+ years of experience supporting complex software, hardware, cloud, cybersecurity, and mission-focused systems. Experienced in system integration, automation testing, verification and validation, test strategy, requirements analysis, acceptance testing, IV&V, RMF/ATO support, and customer coordination across the system development lifecycle.

positions.title: Senior Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Test Planning & Execution: Develop comprehensive test plans to rigorously assess system capabilities, including defining relevant test points, establishing validated data collection procedures, and implementing robust analysis practices. Working using multiple test methodologies such as Unit Testing, Integration Testing, System Testing and Acceptance Testing. Utilize multiple automation test suits such as Selenium, Cucumber and Playwright.
- Logistics Coordination: Manage all aspects of test range logistics, working closely with customers and stakeholders to ensure seamless test execution. This includes scheduling, resource allocation, safety protocols, and data security.
- Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact for customer organizations and internal program leadership, providing clear and concise updates on test program status, plans, roadblocks, and results.
- Team Integration: Collaborate effectively with test effort co-performers to ensure seamless platform and system integration, proactively identifying and resolving potential issues. Support integration with cloud development teams in AWS, Azure and Google Cloud. Support CI/CD pipeline for new deployment and software update.
- Reporting & Analysis: Generate detailed test reports documenting test results, analysis findings, and recommendations for improvement. Perform technical writing in creating Standard Operation Procedures (SOP) and procedures related to current production and in-development systems.
- Security Responsibility: Working closely with ISSE/ISSM to provide comparation between technical specification and security requirements. Support in review and feedback in POA&M entries within customer systems. Verify risk mitigation system and validate backup, recovery and security resiliency systems.
- Leadership & Mentorship: Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers involved in test activities.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Perform testing for an Intelligence client throughout the project life cycle resulting in end-use by the customer.
- Prepare and deliver test reports, time charges to the correct task, program documentation used to conduct technical exchange meeting and acceptance review documentation.
- Travel to vendor site to perform Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT).
- Conduct pre-travel test on vendor software to ensure tool requirements are successfully working on a high level to lower risk of tool failure during FAT.
- Provide operational support to customers before and during use of software.
- Support project coordination maintaining oversight of activities related to system development and test between groups, clients, end-users, developers, vendors and testers of hardware and software.
- Ensure quality of delivery satisfies customer needs.
- Provide Agile and Independent Verification and Validation (IV&V) testing of various computer hardware devices, software programs, and wireless system mitigating the number of discrepancies found prior to formal tests.
- Help ISSE/ISSM validate security requirements during the testing planning and strategizing. Provide input for security and risk assessment based on industry standards and project specific technical requirements.
- Responsible for systems engineering tasks including defining specific technical and test requirements prior to systems development; generating requirement specification; performing risk analysis methods and techniques; identifying and resolving technical system requirements and/or interface problems; developing testable requirements; evaluating test data; determining performance metrics; and ensuring projects or programs meet established milestones.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Created and implemented testing methods, recording the test results.
- Provided recommendations to improve software programs based on the results.
- Coordinated the process for analyzing software programs and applications from the customer.
- Collaborated with organizational management to streamline operations, utilizing programming languages to create testing scripts, and documenting software testing procedures.
- Worked with team members and developers to develop software programs that meet business needs.
- Provide support to ISSE/ISSM team in security review and feedbacks in both the Risk Management Framework (RMF) process and the security authorization package (ATO) management. Included supporting in writing risk mitigation and risk assessment documents.
- Interfaced with end users to ascertain areas of improvement and provide automation solution.
- Worked with testing scripts such as Junit and Selenium Webdriver.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Responsible for the integration and test of various software and hardware.
- Supported development and executed comprehensive procedures that verify all physical and functional device interface requirements.
- Ensured the availability during integration of required support equipment, including tools, test equipment and system accessibility.
- Fabricated, assembled, inspected, tested, and operated final product and support equipment.
- Performed set-up and test of various hardware according to customer's requirements.
- Worked with engineers and technicians to develop test and operational procedures.
- Familiar with project development process to support dev. testers and developers.
- Supervised assembly and test procedures executed by other engineers.
- Supported security testing for both software and hardware in conjunction with feedback from ISSE/ISSM team members. Provide feedbacks to security team to update documentation base on test result and advice security requirement base on user testing.
- Supported engineering boards to determine or resolve issues related to integration and testing.
- Worked on various testing software such as Snowflakes, Flounders and Desktop Wraiths.

projects.title: Collegiate Cyber Defense Competition
projects.description: Participate as Vice-Captain of George Mason University’s team. Focuses on the operational aspect of managing and protecting an existing “commercial” network infrastructure include cyber-attacks and defend against such attacks from the Red Team.

projects.title: Senior Design Project
projects.description:
Senior Design capstone course. Two year project that uses knowledge and skills acquired from past and current education at George Mason University. 

A group of six Applied Information Technology students (all from different technical backgrounds and concentrations) are sent out into the entrepreneurship/business world, to pick a company in need of advancements in business and technology. The main goal is to produce higher profit levels using Technology and Business skills.
